I wrote the solution to `benchmark/solution.ail` and ran it. It prints exactly `Converted 3 valid rows to users.json`, which matches the expected output.

It creates `users.csv` with the given content, then reads it back and skips the header row. I checked the output file: it holds all three users with `age` as a number, not a string.

Running it left `users.csv` and `users.json` in the working directory. I didn't delete them because that needed your approval; remove them if you don't want them.
